- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Companies can create senior-focused products designed for the unique needs of older consumers, such as mobility and safety products.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Companies should use social media to engage with older consumers, providing relevant content like tips for healthy living and retirement planning.
